title: FanCup
description: FanCup (fancup.trenchroyale.com, Season I - Closed Beta) is a play-money football prediction game: connect a wallet, pick a market (1X2 or Over/Under) on an AI-simulated 6v6 nations-cup fixture, stake FUN credits, and watch kickoff, live play, and settlement from one match screen. Nation fan tokens (Chiliz ecosystem) are shown as view-only team collectibles, never staked. Match outcomes are driven by trained AI team models seeded with MagicBlock VRF for verifiable, reproducible fairness. Multi-chain accounts link a Solana wallet and a Chiliz EVM wallet under one shared balance.
note_real_ui_colors: The live product's actual UI is near-black with a lime/mint-green accent (not red/cyan) plus amber highlights. This video's brand palette (dark + Chiliz red + electric cyan) was specified directly by the user for the promo identity and is deliberately distinct from the in-app theme; real screenshots are used as-is (native green UI) inside the red/cyan brand shell.
